notes.title: Quality of life update
notes.content:
This update introduces the following changes:

[list]
[*]Mid-level saving: If you exit a level, a Resume-button will now appear in the main menu.
[*]You can now mark nodes as [i]maybe [/i]blank/colorful using the middle mouse button.
[*]The Settings menu can now be accessed from in-game.
[*]There is now a button to restart the current level in-game.
[*]There is now a setting to turn off the mistakes counter.
[*]Adjusted some wording in the tutorial.
[/list]
